question.text: What should you know about pedestrian unpredictability?

answer.text: Yield to pedestrians and stay alert because they can be hard to see and may cross outside marked crosswalks or disregard signals.

teaching.text: Remember pedestrian unpredictability. Yield to pedestrians and stay alert because they can be hard to see and may cross outside marked crosswalks or disregard signals.

question.text: What should you know about blind pedestrian priority?

answer.text: A blind or visually impaired pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog has the right of way.

teaching.text: Remember blind pedestrian priority. A blind or visually impaired pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog has the right of way.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: A blind or visually impaired pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog has the right of way.

answer.text: Yield to pedestrians when making a turn.

question.text: What should you know about motorcyclist rights?

answer.text: Motorcycle riders have the same roadway rights and duties as other drivers, although they can be harder to see.

answer.text: Give a motorcycle the full width of its lane so its rider has room to respond to other traffic.

answer.text: Do not assume a motorcycle will turn merely because its signal flashes, since the signal may not cancel automatically and may have been left on.
